whyItMatters: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a repository URL of the `file:` scheme.
actions: Depend on a published, versioned artifact, and keep local paths or branch references out of the committed manifest. Specifically: fix a repository URL of the `file:` scheme.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm build.gradle no longer carries a repository URL of the `file:` scheme.
